sys_remote_update_set.description: Enables the platform behaviour that keeps an application vulnerable item in the Deferred state when the scanner closes it and finds it again while its approved deferral (Until date) is still valid: property sn_vul.auto_defer_avit_in_active_exception_window set to true. The out-of-box before rule "Run exception rules" on the application vulnerable item then restores state Deferred with the original reason on the scanner re-open, increments the defer count and writes a work note; a manual re-open is not affected.
sys_remote_update_set.name: SNOWUSEMTP-1552_MS_AVIT Deferral Kept On Scanner Reopen_V1.0
